las 5 columnas del coordinador existen con su tipo y son NULL-able

SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='case_reviews' AND ((column_name='coordinator_decision' AND data_type='text' AND is_nullable='YES') OR (column_name='coordinator_resolution' AND data_type='text' AND is_nullable='YES') OR (column_name='coordinator_created_by' AND data_type='uuid' AND is_nullable='YES') OR (column_name='coordinator_created_at' AND data_type='timestamp with time zone' AND is_nullable='YES') OR (column_name='coordinator_comment' AND data_type='text' AND is_nullable='YES'))
el CHECK de vocabulario de la decision existe y admite APPROVE y CHANGE

SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.case_reviews'::regclass AND contype='c' AND conname='case_reviews_coordinator_decision_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%APPROVE%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%CHANGE%'
el CHECK de consistencia de tabla existe
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.case_reviews'::regclass AND contype='c' AND conname='case_reviews_coordinator_consistency_check'
el CHECK de consistencia exige que CHANGE produzca una resolucion DISTINTA de la del asesor (result)

SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.case_reviews'::regclass AND contype='c' AND conname='case_reviews_coordinator_consistency_check' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%DISTINCT%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%result%'
el actor del coordinador es una FK a auth.users (identidad real, no texto)

SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.case_reviews'::regclass AND contype='f' AND confrelid='auth.users'::regclass AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%coordinator_created_by%'
la resolucion del asesor (result) sigue siendo text NOT NULL: esta migracion no la toca
SELECT count(*)::int AS total FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='case_reviews' AND column_name='result' AND data_type='text' AND is_nullable='NO'
